span.p:
16 fighters
practise at once
in one gym

span.p:
Experience
what I saw, what I did,
what it scored

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
PPO
nudge the brain toward
what scored better
— but never too far at once

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
New brain
handed back to
all 16 fighters

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Curriculum
stand still → sway →
shuffle → step → stride → walk
each rung unlocks only when
the score clears its gate

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
~2,000 steps a second
18 million steps ≈ 2.5 hours
